bio: Enjoy a classic afternoon tea for two at the Best Western Normanton Park Hotel.  Treat yourself and a loved one to this afternoon tea experience at the Best Western Normanton Park Hotel. Dating back to 1829, Normanton Park has been making its guests feel welcome for decades and will provide you with a warm welcome as you're seated in the restaurant.  You'll get to tuck into a delicious array of savoury and sweet treats, with finger sandwiches, scones with cream and jam, teas and coffees, tempting cakes and pastries to complete your afternoon's culinary experience in historic surroundings.
